project_name: NivXRay XDR - Data Sources / Windows UI Redesign Blueprint

typography.display: Outfit (700/800 weight, tracking-tight) for Page Titles & Hero Metrics
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (400/500/600 weight) for UI labels, table content, and descriptions
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (400/500/700 weight) for Channel IDs, Event IDs, DSM IDs, Technical Tokens, Timestamps

architecture_and_density.row_height: 28px - 32px dense operational row height for NxDataTable
architecture_and_density.layout_grid: Main Content (8 col / 66%) + Summary & Filter Rail (4 col / 33%) in 12-col bento grid
architecture_and_density.zebra_and_borders: 1px solid var(--nx-bd-quiet) subtle rows, alternating row highlights (hover: bg-hover), 1px solid card containment
architecture_and_density.font_hierarchy: Headers in Outfit Bold, technical values in JetBrains Mono text-xs, metadata in IBM Plex Sans text-xs

nx_primitives_mapping.NxPageShell: Top-level layout wrapper with eyebrow='Data Sources', title='Windows', description
nx_primitives_mapping.NxTabs: Tab switcher (Overview | Devices | Channels | Collectors | Coverage | Health | Configuration)
nx_primitives_mapping.NxSurface: Container cards with variant='primary' or variant='inset'. NO empty container bands.
nx_primitives_mapping.NxKpi: KPI summary tiles (Channels declared, Devices, Collectors, Detections fired)
nx_primitives_mapping.NxDataTable: Standard enterprise grid for Channels, Devices, Collectors, Coverage channels, ATT&CK techniques, Health channels, Configuration channels. Replaces raw <table class='wx-kv'>
nx_primitives_mapping.NxFlyout: Side contextual pane for Channel/Coverage citation drilldown (width=720px)
nx_primitives_mapping.NxStatus: High-density status chip mapping state values to distinct tones
nx_primitives_mapping.NxDimensionStrip: PROPOSED NEW NX PRIMITIVE in nx/: Renders horizontal 5-dimension state breakdown (Collection, Parsing, Normalization, Detection capability, Coverage) as dense status-count badges without calculating or implying a composite score
nx_primitives_mapping.NxBlockerGroup: PROPOSED NEW NX PRIMITIVE in nx/: Groups and deduplicates repeated blocker messages with channel tags and affected rule counts

Overview.layout: 2-column layout: Left (Hero KPI Grid + 5-Dimension State Strips + Blocker Summary) | Right (Real Windows Endpoint Proof + Coverage Impact Breakdown + Quick Filters)
Overview.kpi_cards: 4 compact NxKpi tiles inside a single 4-column NxSurface header without empty card margins
Overview.dimension_strips: 5 independent NxDimensionStrip components for Collection, Parsing, Normalization, Detection capability, Coverage. Explicitly renders 'Composite Health = NOT AVAILABLE (never published)' and 'Real Windows Endpoint Proof = NOT PROVEN' with distinct NxStatus chips
Overview.attention_block: NxBlockerGroup summarizing top blockers, grouped by root cause (e.g. 'Missing Sysmon Config Event 1' affecting 4 channels) rather than repeating line-by-line

Coverage.layout: Top summary rail + 3 Onboarding Buckets (Available Now, Potential, Blocked) rendered via NxDataTable + ATT&CK Coverage Matrix / Dense Table
Coverage.attack_section: NxDataTable for ~23 to 100+ ATT&CK techniques with Columns: Technique ID (e.g., T1003.001), Technique Name, Coverage State Chip, Rule Count, Required Telemetry Tokens (Tags), Prerequisite State, Last Detection, Detection Rule Names (Truncated tags with +N expander)

Configuration.layout: NxDataTable for Declared Channel Contract + Supplementary NxSurface for Declared Unsupported channels

absence_handling_rules.rule: Missing measurement MUST render as '—' or 'NOT AVAILABLE' with a faint/dashed status pill. NEVER render as '0' or blank space.
absence_handling_rules.composite_health_policy: Composite Health MUST state 'NOT AVAILABLE' with explanatory note 'Composite health score is deliberately never published to prevent false confidence'.

grids.bento_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboards / Analytics)

layouts.page_structure: NxPageShell > NxTabs > Main Bento Grid (Left Panel 8 cols, Right Summary Rail 4 cols)

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 for body text, >= 3:1 for large display / status pills
accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid on every table, row, button, tab, chip, and field (e.g. data-testid='wx-table-row-sysmon')

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor WindowsPage.jsx, WindowsOverview.jsx, WindowsCoverage.jsx, WindowsChannels.jsx, and WindowsPrimitives.jsx to replace raw <table class='wx-kv'> with NxDataTable and NxSurface panels.
Add new NxDimensionStrip and NxBlockerGroup components to nx/ or WindowsPrimitives.jsx for dense 5-dimension strip and blocker aggregation.
Ensure both Light Mode (.xdr-console[data-nx-theme='light']) and Default Dark Mode render with high-contrast, crisp typography and zero empty card bands.
Verify all missing measurements display '—' or 'NOT AVAILABLE' and data-testid attributes are preserved or expanded on every key component.
